result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with sidewalks on both sides and a faded marked crosswalk. While basic infrastructure like traffic lights and curb ramps are present, the environment lacks high-visibility markings and dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using continental or ladder patterns to increase visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and predictability.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and markings are present, the wide roadway and lack of traffic control or pedestrian refuge islands increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street near the crosswalk obstruct the sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The wide crossing lacks visible stop signs, traffic signals, or flashing beacons to manage vehicle-pedestrian interactions.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with standard pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and signalization. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical separation or refuge islands create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians crossing multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time in the roadway, increasing exposure to vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane one-way urban street with a high-visibility ladder-style crosswalk and a buffered bike lane. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the significant crossing distance and potential for high vehicle speeds on a one-way thoroughfare increase risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to multiple lanes of traffic and a bike lane over a wide span without a mid-crossing refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right curb may obscure pedestrians, especially children or those in wheelchairs, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street adjacent to the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines between motorists and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island between the travel lanes and the buffered bike lane to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in stages.
